title: Incrementing a Counter and Pointer
statement: Let $m$ be a Boolean mode, $y$ a Boolean input word, $r$ one of the four work tapes with $r=0$ or $r=3$, $\ell$ an access label, $i,k,p$ natural numbers, and $q$ an integer. Suppose $-1\le q\le$ the bit-length of $|y|+1$, and the value stored on tape $r$ in the tuple $(i,0,k,p)$, plus one, is at most $|y|+1$. There is a finite sequence of access-machine steps from the configuration with state “increment on tape $r$ with label $\ell$,” tapes encoding $i,0,k,p$, and tape-$2$ head at $q$, to the configuration with state “read label $\ell$ in phase eC,” with the counter for tape $0$ increased by one if $r=0$, the counter for tape $3$ increased by one if $r=3$, and the other entries unchanged; the tape-$2$ head remains at $q$.
